item.title: Disney Celebrates Controversial Disney Channel Star With Special Display
item.description: Walt Disney Archives showcased two costumes, Miley's guitar, and Hannah's iconic wig at the premiere of the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special. The special display featured recognizable props and wardrobe pieces from the beloved series, which premiered 20 years ago and influenced a generation's views on music, fame, and identity.

item.title: Disney Extends Helping Hand to Foreign Countries During Hard Times
item.description: As Earth Month approaches, The Walt Disney Company is showcasing global conservation and sustainability stories to celebrate Earth Day on April 22. They are supporting 25 organizations across 16 countries through the Disney Conservation Fund, bringing their total global investment to over $141 million since 1995.
